body.zh-Hant: 阿爾瓦羅·奧夫雷貢·薩利多生於1880年2月19日，是十八個孩子中最年幼的一個，出身索諾拉南部一個顯赫家族中較貧困的親屬。他曾在叔舅們的麵粉廠當機械工，1909年發明了一種鷹嘴豆播種機。
body.en: Álvaro Obregón Salido was born on 19 February 1880, the last of eighteen children, the poor relation of one of southern Sonora's most prominent families. He began work as a mechanic at his uncles' flour mill, and in 1909 he invented a chick-pea planter.

heading.zh-Hant: 從奧羅斯科戰役到萊昂之役
heading.en: From the Orozco campaign to the Battle of León

body.zh-Hant: 1912年4月，奧夫雷貢以市長身分奉召招募部隊對抗奧羅斯科叛亂，募得三百人，並出任第四索諾拉非正規營中校。為對抗1913年初韋爾塔推翻馬德羅的政變，他被任命為州軍隊指揮；同年5月升為准將，其後被卡蘭薩任為東北軍總司令。1915年6月的萊昂之役中他負傷，失去右臂。
body.en: In April 1912 Obregón, as mayor, was called on to raise troops against the Orozco rebellion; he recruited three hundred men and was named lieutenant colonel of the Fourth Sonoran Irregular Battalion. He was named chief of the state's forces to oppose the Huerta coup against Francisco Madero in early 1913; he became a brigadier general in May 1913 and was then made commander in chief of the Army of the Northeast by Carranza. He was wounded and lost his right arm at the Battle of León in June 1915.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭部長與返回私人生活
heading.en: Secretary of war and return to private life

body.zh-Hant: 1916年3月，卡蘭薩任命奧夫雷貢為戰爭部長，以配合對維拉的戰事。他利用這個職位開始改組軍隊、推動專業化，並在制憲會議中與激進派站在一起。1917年5月，他辭去內閣職務，返回私人生活。1919年6月，他宣布參選總統。
body.en: In March 1916 Carranza made Obregón secretary of war to facilitate the campaign against Villa. He used the post to begin the reorganization and professionalization of the army and associated himself at the constitutional convention with the radicals. In May 1917 he resigned from the cabinet and returned to private life, and in June 1919 he announced his candidacy for the presidency.

heading.zh-Hant: 阿瓜普列塔叛亂與總統任期
heading.en: The Agua Prieta revolt and the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1920年4月，卡蘭薩把奧夫雷貢及其支持者逼入武裝反抗；不到一個月，卡蘭薩死亡，叛軍獲勝，奧夫雷貢隨後以壓倒性票數當選總統。他於1920年12月1日就任，首要目標是平定全國。1923年的布卡雷利條約為他換得美國的外交承認；同年他支持卡列斯為繼任者，引發德拉韋塔領導的叛亂，他擊敗叛軍，任滿後把權力交給卡列斯。
body.en: In April 1920 Carranza pushed Obregón and his supporters into armed rebellion; within a month Carranza was dead and the rebels had triumphed, paving the way for Obregón's landslide election to the presidency. He was inaugurated on 1 December 1920, his main objective being the pacification of Mexico. Through the Bucareli Treaty of 1923 he secured diplomatic recognition from the United States; his support of Calles as successor galvanized a rebellion led by de la Huerta in 1923, which he defeated, and he finished his full term and handed power to Calles.

body.zh-Hant: 1926年10月，國會經過激烈辯論修改憲法，為奧夫雷貢再度參選鋪路。他在1928年無對手參選，卻未能第二次就任：1928年7月，當選總統的他在墨西哥城的一場宴會上遇害，遵照其遺願葬於索諾拉。
body.en: In October 1926 Congress, after stormy debate, changed the constitution to pave the way for Obregón's reelection as president. He ran unopposed in 1928 but did not live to take office a second time: President-elect Obregón met his death at a banquet in Mexico City in July 1928 and, in keeping with his wishes, was buried in his home state of Sonora.

body.zh-Hant: 巴爾塔薩·布魯姆1883年6月18日生於薩爾托附近的阿蒂加斯省，是巴西裔地主之子。他進入蒙特維多大學讀法律，1908年取得法學博士學位，並在薩爾托執業。
body.en: Baltasar Brum was born on 18 June 1883 in the Department of Artigas near the city of Salto, the son of landowners of Brazilian origin. He read law at the University of Montevideo, won his degree as Doctor of Jurisprudence in 1908, and began to practise in Salto.

body.zh-Hant: 到三十歲時，布魯姆已是教育部長，任期為1913至1915年；數月後他曾被任為外交部臨時部長，並在維埃拉總統任內出任內政部長。他在1916年重回外交部，直到1919年3月1日在國會聯席會議上當選總統為止；這三年間他談成多項條約，並應威爾遜總統特別邀請，乘烏拉圭巡洋艦「蒙特維多」號訪美。
body.en: By the age of thirty Brum was minister of education (1913–1915); a few months later he was made minister pro tempore of foreign affairs, and under President Viera he served as minister of the interior. In 1916 he was recalled to the Foreign Office, which he filled until his election as President in the joint session of Congress on 1 March 1919. During these three years he negotiated a number of treaties and, at the special invitation of President Wilson, went to the United States in the Uruguayan cruiser Montevideo.

body.zh-Hant: 布魯姆信奉巴特列主義，特別是其改革傾向。他是烏拉圭有史以來當選最年輕的總統，任期為1919至1923年，也是第一位在總統與國家行政委員會並立的集體行政體制下施政的總統。任內推動了有利工人階級的立法，例如農村勞工的最低工資；在對外事務上，他是仲裁的熱情倡導者，並與巴西議定了無限制的仲裁條約。
body.en: Brum subscribed to the beliefs of Batllism, specifically to its reformist tendencies. He was the youngest President ever elected in Uruguay and served as president from 1919 to 1923, the first to govern under a collegial executive consisting of the president and the National Council of Administration. During his administration legislation for the benefit of the working class was promoted, such as a minimum wage for rural laborers; in foreign affairs he was an earnest champion of arbitration and arranged an unrestricted treaty of arbitration with Brazil.

heading.zh-Hant: 國家行政委員會與自殺
heading.en: The National Council and his suicide

body.zh-Hant: 1929至1931年，布魯姆擔任國家行政委員會主席；他所屬的該委員會不止一次與總統對峙。1933年，泰拉掌握獨裁權力時，布魯姆在3月31日於公開場合自殺，作為一種象徵姿態，儘管他的個人自由並未受到威脅。
body.en: From 1929 to 1931 Brum was president of the National Council of Administration, to which he belonged and which confronted the president on more than one occasion. When Terra assumed dictatorial powers in 1933, Brum committed suicide in public on 31 March as a symbolic gesture, even though his personal liberty was not at stake.

body.zh-Hant: 費利西亞諾·維埃拉1872年11月8日生於薩爾托，父親是同名的費利西亞諾·維埃拉，母親是佩特羅納·博爾赫斯。他在薩爾托開始求學，十五歲時前往蒙特維多進入大學，1898年取得律師學位。
body.en: Feliciano Viera was born on 8 November 1872 in the town of Salto, the son of Feliciano Viera and Petrona Borges. He began his education there, went to Montevideo and entered the University when he was fifteen, and in 1898 received his degree of Advocate.

body.zh-Hant: 1898年，維埃拉進入庫埃斯塔斯總統所設的國務會議任職，但不久辭去；同年政府任命他為阿蒂加斯省的民政長官兼警察首長，1899年他當選薩爾托的眾議員，1901年連任。1904年革命爆發時，巴特列總統把國民警衛隊第九營交由他指揮；1905年他再度當選眾議員，次年當選里維拉省的參議員。
body.en: In 1898 Viera began his political career with a post in the Council of State created by President Cuestas, which he resigned very soon afterwards; the Government nominated him Civil Governor and head of the Police in the Department of Artigas, and in 1899 he was elected Deputy for El Salto, being re-elected in 1901. At the beginning of the revolution of 1904 President Batlle put the 9th Battalion of the National Guard under his charge; in 1905 he was again elected Deputy for El Salto and one year afterwards Senator for the Department of Rivera.

heading.zh-Hant: 參議院議長與內政部長
heading.en: Senate presiding officer and minister of the interior

body.zh-Hant: 進入上院後，維埃拉很快成為議長，並在六年的參議員任期內一直擔任此職。巴特列再度出任總統時，他受命掌管內政部，這是當時行政部門中最重要的內閣職位；直到國民大會任命他為共和國總統。
body.en: On entering the Upper House Viera soon became its presiding officer, a position he kept during the six years of his senatorship. When Batlle again became President, Viera was entrusted with the portfolio of the Interior, at this time the most important cabinet position in the administration, until the General Assembly appointed him President of the Republic.

body.zh-Hant: 維埃拉在任期間公共秩序從未受到擾亂，並完成了憲法改革，使烏拉圭有了新的組織憲章；他任內烏拉圭與德國斷交。1916年法國政府授予他榮譽軍團十字勳章。同年巴特列派的憲法計畫在投票中失敗，維埃拉成為遏止先前社會改革的運動主力，並向科羅拉多黨全國大會宣布需要對改革「暫停」，因而獲得保守派的信任。1919年他把總統權力移交給繼任者布魯姆。
body.en: While Viera was President the public peace was never disturbed, and constitutional reform gave Uruguay its new organic charter; during his administration Uruguay broke off relations with Germany. In 1916 the French Government bestowed on him the Cross of the Legion of Honour. After the failure of the Batllist constitutional project at the polls in 1916 he became the main force behind a movement to halt the social reforms of previous periods, announcing to the Colorado Party's National Convention the need for a halt to the reforms, and so obtained a vote of confidence from the conservatives. In 1919 he transmitted the presidential power to his successor Baltasar Brum.

heading.zh-Hant: 國家行政委員會主席與晚年
heading.en: Chair of the National Council and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1919年3月1日新憲法生效，國家行政委員會首屆主席的職位落在維埃拉身上；依前任總統的資格，他可擔任這個新機構的主席兩年。他從巴特列派分裂出來，形成名為「維埃拉主義」的派系，屬科羅拉多黨中的反巴特列派。他於1927年11月13日去世，這個派系隨他的死亡而失去影響力。
body.en: The new constitution came into force on 1 March 1919, and the chairmanship of the first National Council of Administration fell to Viera; by reason of his rank as ex-President it was his prerogative to occupy the presidency of this new committee for two years. He had separated from the main body of the Batllists to give rise to a faction known as Vierismo, one of the anti-Batllist branches of the Colorado Party. He died on 13 November 1927, and the faction lost relevance with his death.
